assets.name: 01_CorridorArchitecture.png
assets.prompt: Create a production 2D game sprite layer from the supplied APPROVED palace corridor layout. Single wide panoramic image roughly 3:1, transparent PNG. Asset: ARCHITECTURE AND WALKABLE FLOOR ONLY. Preserve the exact long horizontal corridor, far-left raised room, reduced small doorway aligned with the upper stair landing, connected six stair steps, long red carpet, six tall arched windows, and opaque right closing end wall. Preserve scale and route. REMOVE the ghosted big near-foreground arrival arch completely (it will be a separate sprite), retain its carpet approach. Remove ALL landscape and sky from every window pane: each glass pane must be genuinely transparent alpha, while its dark mullions and muted bronze arch remain solid. No reflections painted across the empty panes. Keep dark solid interior wall above and below windows and floor opaque; transparent outside the architecture silhouette. STYLE IMPORTANT: much flatter and more graphic than reference, black and charcoal blue-gray broad silhouette fills, restrained flat old-gold outline shapes, dark burgundy carpet, simple decorative molding, crisp clean illustrated edges. At most two or three flat values per material. No realistic stone texture, grain, noise, metallic gleam, photoreal shading, ambient occlusion, volumetric light, painterly brush detail or 3D-render material. Candle sconces as simple small graphic symbols, no baked light bloom. Architectural form still readable using simple flat faces. This layer will sit over independently moving window scenery. No characters, furniture, additional doors, labels, grid, checkerboard imitation, captions or watermark. Transparent background must be actual alpha, especially within all window panes.

assets.name: 02_EntranceFrame.png
assets.prompt: Production 2D game sprite, only ONE isolated empty palace corridor entrance arch, front-on, on genuinely transparent alpha. Match reference dark silhouette architecture, charcoal blue-gray flat fill with restrained old bronze outlines. Two narrow upright jambs, a simple rounded arch and small square foot blocks resting on exactly the same baseline. Completely empty transparent opening. NO door leaf, hinge, handle, floor, carpet, background, wall, scenery, captions or shadows. Clean minimal flat vector-like illustration, no photoreal material, stone texture, noise, bevel render or gradients. Fully opaque painted frame so opacity can later be controlled in Unity; do not bake fading into this source. The arch is a near-foreground passage frame for the approved scene, not a freestanding fantasy portal. Tall portrait 2:3 composition with modest transparent padding, entire frame unclipped.

assets.name: 03_NearTrees.png
assets.prompt: Create ONE isolated wide 3:1 landscape transparent PNG game parallax layer of NEAR deciduous trees for the night palace windows in the reference. ONLY near tree silhouettes, no architecture. Two sparse groups of near-black deep blue-green tree trunks toward left and right thirds, branching irregular crowns, crisp clusters of simplified pointed leaves, center substantially open to see distant layers. Roots and low shrubs form sparse lower edge, foliage occupies sides and upper corners; avoid an opaque continuous forest wall. Cohesive hand-cut silhouette game art, large flat color shapes using just 2 extremely dark values. No bark rendering, highlights, photo textures, light beams, blur, fog, sky, mountains or buildings. Background and all gaps between branches genuinely transparent alpha. Entire principal tree shapes within canvas with slight transparent padding; widest side branches may approach edges. No labels.

assets.name: 04_MidForest.png
assets.prompt: One production 2D side-scroller parallax sprite layer for a dark silhouette palace night setting: MIDDLE-DISTANCE WOODLAND ONLY. Extra-wide 3:1 transparent PNG. A continuous irregular band of distant deciduous tree canopies and a few pointed trees, gently rising and dipping across width, occupying lower 40 percent of image, opaque woodland continuing to bottom edge. Broad crisp simplified silhouettes, one main dark desaturated blue-green fill #142d36 and only a few flat darker overlapping canopy groups. Top 60 percent and spaces above treeline fully transparent. No foreground trees, sky, clouds, mountains, architecture, moon, ground reflections. No gradients, realistic lighting, texture, leaf detail, blur or fog. Elegant ominous paper-cut illustration, clean uneven organic outline, consistent with muted charcoal/old-gold palace art. No text, border, grid, checkerboard pattern. This is a single separable parallax layer, not a finished landscape.

assets.name: 05_FarMountains.png
assets.prompt: One production game background layer, wide 3:1 transparent PNG, only a LONG DISTANT MOUNTAIN RIDGE silhouette for a dark night palace corridor. A sparse elegant sequence of irregular angular rounded mountain peaks, highest peak a little right of center, skyline near middle height, entire mountain mass below skyline to image bottom opaque. One unified flat muted blue-gray #263d4b silhouette, no internal rock detail, no highlights, no texture, no realistic gradients. Empty sky above mountains completely transparent alpha. Minimal flat hand-cut shape compatible with gothic silhouette art, restrained dark tones, visually quieter than near blue-green trees. No trees, forest, clouds, moon, stars, architecture, objects, labels, borders or backdrop. Keep mountains wide and low, not huge towering alpine peaks. Both sides terminate at similar low horizon height to support horizontal camera panning.

assets.name: 06_Clouds.png
assets.prompt: Production 2D parallax game layer on actual transparent alpha, extra wide 3:1. ONLY six separated long low NIGHT CLOUD silhouette shapes, irregular graceful flat shapes spread across upper and middle parts of the canvas, with large transparent gaps. Dark muted desaturated blue-gray #344b59 at full opacity so game renderer can tune opacity. Flat paper-cut illustration: crisp angular-tapered wisps and gently scalloped edges, one solid fill per cloud, no shading, no white highlights, no realistic vapor, no softness, no glow, no noise. Do not paint a sky, ground, moon, stars, mountains, trees or buildings. Clouds fully inside canvas, modest transparent margins, no clipping. Restrained gothic palace night visual style. No labels, no checkerboard imitation.

assets.name: 07_NightSky.png
assets.prompt: Production 2D game sky backing texture, wide 3:1. Empty dark desaturated navy-blue night sky, subtle vertical transition from very dark blue #101d29 at top to muted slate blue #263d4b at bottom. Almost flat and extremely restrained, smooth clean color field. Absolutely NO clouds, stars, moon, sun, mountains, tree, buildings, objects, vignette, glow, texture, paper grain, noise, brush marks or text. This is the opaque backmost layer behind separately authored silhouette clouds and mountains, not a complete landscape. Dark graphic palette, not photographic.

assets.name: 02_EntranceFrame.png revision
assets.prompt: Correct this isolated arch frame sprite. REMOVE the ENTIRE blurry gold/brown halo and all background pixels around and inside the frame. The only remaining visible pixels must belong to the solid sharply defined arch frame itself. All space outside the frame AND the opening between its jambs must be truly fully transparent alpha. Preserve exact frame silhouette, charcoal flat fill, thin muted bronze borders and two small aligned square base blocks. Reduce surface shading to flat solid illustration color; absolutely NO glow, blur, shadow, lighting falloff or gradients extending off the object. No backdrop, checkerboard pattern or ambient color cloud. A clean 2D game cutout asset like an opaque paper-cut frame floating on actual transparent canvas, tall portrait. No added objects.

assets.name: 02_EntranceFrame.png final
assets.prompt: A minimalist flat cut-paper archway game sprite on TRANSPARENT background. Just one inverted U shape with vertical parallel sides and a round arch top. Solid dark charcoal flat fill, with a narrow dull brown outline, two small rectangular feet on a shared baseline. It is an empty palace doorframe with no door. Portrait canvas. Exactly three flat ink colors only: charcoal #182128, dull ochre brown #786442, black #101419. No other colors and NO pixels whatsoever beyond the hard outline of the inverted U and its feet. Empty center and exterior are alpha zero. Strict cutout graphic design, like a stencil or a simple vector icon. There is NO glow, no soft shadow, no aura, no lighting effect, no background gradient, no texture, no blur, no backdrop and no ground plane. Flat hard-edged sprite only. Narrow frame suitable to fade in a 2D gothic palace game. No text.
